_about: Minimal (clinically) important differences used by risk_numbers.meaningful(). EMPTY by design: BioSynthetica does not invent thresholds. Add the ones your field uses, each with its source, e.g. "systolic blood pressure": {"value": 5, "unit": "mmHg", "source": "<guideline or paper>"}. Endpoint names are matched case-insensitively against the finding's endpoint.
